module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades A to F and count how many students earned each grade.

public type GradeError is one of
  purpose: The reasons a score cannot be graded.
  OutOfRange(score: Decimal)
end

public function letter_for(score: Decimal)
  returns Text
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Give the letter grade for one score using the 90, 80, 70 and 60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grade_all
  example: letter_for(score: 95.0) is "A"
  example: letter_for(score: 80.0) is "B"
  example: letter_for(score: 79.5) is "C"
  example: letter_for(score: 60.0) is "D"
  example: letter_for(score: 12.0) is "F"

  if score is less than 0.0 or score is greater than 100.0 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90.0 then
    return "A"
  otherwise if score is at least 80.0 then
    return "B"
  otherwise if score is at least 70.0 then
    return "C"
  otherwise if score is at least 60.0 then
    return "D"
  otherwise
    return "F"
  end
end

public function grade_all(scores: List of Decimal)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Turn every score in the list into its letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_for
  example: grade_all(scores: [95.0, 85.0, 10.0]) is ["A", "B", "F"]

  let mutable grades: List of Text be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be letter_for(score: score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Decimal)
  returns Map of Text to Integer
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Count how many students got each letter grade; every grade from A to F is present, with zero when nobody earned it.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grade_all
  example: count_grades(scores: [95.0, 85.0, 40.0]) is {"A": 1, "B": 1, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 1}

  let grades be grade_all(scores: scores) otherwise fail
  let mutable counts be {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 0}
  for each grade in grades
    let current be counts.get(grade) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: grade, value: current + 1)
  end
  return counts
end

test "cut-offs belong to the higher grade"
  check letter_for(score: 90.0) is "A"
  check letter_for(score: 89.9) is "B"
  check letter_for(score: 70.0) is "C"
end

test "scores outside 0 to 100 are rejected"
  check letter_for(score: 101.0) is not "A"
end

module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades A to F and count how many students earned each grade.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade, from A (best) to F (failing).
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
end

public type ScoreError is one of
  purpose: The reason a score could not be graded.
  OutOfRange(score: Integer)
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: The number of students who received each letter grade.
  has a_count: Integer
  has b_count: Integer
  has c_count: Integer
  has d_count: Integer
  has f_count: Integer
end

public function grade_for(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert one score into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grades_for
  example: grade_for(95) is A
  example: grade_for(80) is B
  example: grade_for(70) is C
  example: grade_for(65) is D
  example: grade_for(12) is F

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function grades_for(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert every score in the list into a letter grade, keeping the order; fails if any score is outside 0 to 100.
  tags: grading
  see also: grade_for
  example: grades_for([95, 85, 59]) is [A, B, F]

  let grades be
    for each score in scores
    collect grade_for(score) otherwise fail
  return grades
end

public function count_grades(grades: List of Grade)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grades_for
  example: count_grades([A, A, B, F]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 1)

  let a_total be for each grade in grades where grade is A count
  let b_total be for each grade in grades where grade is B count
  let c_total be for each grade in grades where grade is C count
  let d_total be for each grade in grades where grade is D count
  let f_total be for each grade in grades where grade is F count
  return GradeCounts(a_count: a_total, b_count: b_total, c_count: c_total, d_count: d_total, f_count: f_total)
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check grade_for(90) is A
  check grade_for(89) is B
  check grade_for(60) is D
  check grade_for(59) is F
end

test "grades are counted per letter"
  let counts be count_grades([C, C, C, D])
  check counts.c_count is 3
  check counts.d_count is 1
  check counts.a_count is 0
end

  purpose: Convert one score to a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grades_for
  example: grade_for(score: 95) is GradeA
  example: grade_for(score: 80) is GradeB
  example: grade_for(score: 79) is GradeC
  example: grade_for(score: 60) is GradeD
  example: grade_for(score: 59) is GradeF

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with ScoreOutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then

  otherwise
    return GradeF

public function grades_for(scores: List of Integer)

  purpose: Convert every score in the list to a letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  see also: grade_for
  example: grades_for(scores: [95, 85, 40]) is [GradeA, GradeB, GradeF]

  let mutable grades: List of Grade be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be grade_for(score: score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function count_by_grade(grades: List of Grade)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade, including grades nobody received.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grades_for
  example: count_by_grade(grades: [GradeA, GradeA, GradeC]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 0)

  let total_a be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count
  let total_b be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeB count
  let total_c be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeC count
  let total_d be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeD count

end

public function count_scores(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with GradingError
  purpose: Grade a list of scores and count how many students got each grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grades_for, count_by_grade
  example: count_scores(scores: [91, 72, 65, 30]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 1, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 1, grade_f: 1)

  let grades be grades_for(scores: scores) otherwise fail
  return count_by_grade(grades: grades)
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check grade_for(score: 90) is GradeA
  check grade_for(score: 89) is GradeB
  check grade_for(score: 70) is GradeC
  check grade_for(score: 0) is GradeF
end

test "counts include grades nobody got"
  let counts be count_by_grade(grades: [GradeB, GradeB, GradeF])
  check counts.grade_b is 2
  check counts.grade_a is 0
  check counts.grade_f is 1

module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades A to F and count how many students earned each grade.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade, from GradeA (best) to GradeF (worst).
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
  can ToText
end

public type ScoreError is one of
  purpose: Why a score could not be graded.
  OutOfRange(score: Integer)
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: How many students received each letter grade.
  has a_count: Integer
  has b_count: Integer
  has c_count: Integer
  has d_count: Integer
  has f_count: Integer
end

public function letter_for(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert one score from 0 to 100 into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grades_for
  example: letter_for(95) is GradeA
  example: letter_for(90) is GradeA
  example: letter_for(89) is GradeB
  example: letter_for(70) is GradeC
  example: letter_for(60) is GradeD
  example: letter_for(59) is GradeF

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function grades_for(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert every score in the list into a letter grade, keeping the original order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_for
  example: grades_for([95, 85, 40]) is [GradeA, GradeB, GradeF]

  let mutable result: List of Grade be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be letter_for(score) otherwise fail
    set result to result.append(grade)
  end
  return result
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: letter_for
  example: count_grades([95, 91, 85, 72, 65, 10]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 1, d_count: 1, f_count: 1)

  let mutable a_total be 0
  let mutable b_total be 0
  let mutable c_total be 0
  let mutable d_total be 0
  let mutable f_total be 0
  for each score in scores
    let grade be letter_for(score) otherwise fail
    match grade
      when GradeA then set a_total to a_total + 1
      when GradeB then set b_total to b_total + 1
      when GradeC then set c_total to c_total + 1
      when GradeD then set d_total to d_total + 1
      when GradeF then set f_total to f_total + 1
    end
  end
  return GradeCounts(a_count: a_total, b_count: b_total, c_count: c_total, d_count: d_total, f_count: f_total)
end
